title: 预测辅助与探索性压缩的时间动态
summary: 本文提出一个几何动力学框架，研究预测性AI系统如何通过外源性探索压缩稳定决策轨迹，从而改变人类探索性认知的时间动态。主要发现：持续预测稳定会降低探索响应性；曲率不对称累积导致滞后和恢复延迟；早期干预会限制未来的探索广度。
summary_en: This paper proposes a geometric dynamical framework to study how predictive AI systems reshape exploratory cognition through exogenous exploratory compression. Key findings: sustained predictive stabilization reduces exploratory responsiveness; asymmetric curvature accumulation causes hysteresis and delayed recovery; early intervention narrows future exploratory traversal.
